exercises.prompt: Which phrase is the driver's polite "At your service"?

too_formal.feedback: That is a formal service phrase; drivers say تحت أمرك.

exercises.tip: "تحت أمرك" literally means under your command.

exercises.prompt: You ask a taxi: "فاضي؟" and he is taken. What does he say?

too_formal.feedback: That is formal; a driver just says مشغول.

exercises.tip: "مشغول" means busy.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "How long will the way take?"

too_formal.feedback: That is formal; Cairenes say قد إيه for how much or how long.

exercises.tip: "قد إيه" asks how much or how long.

exercises.prompt: Complete: "الأتوبيس بييجي الساعة _____ بكرة؟" Meaning: What time does the bus come tomorrow?

too_formal.feedback: That is formal; the Egyptian way is الساعة كام.

exercises.tip: "الساعة كام؟" asks what time it is.

exercises.prompt: Translate: "Take me to the station." (to a man)

too_formal.feedback: That is formal; speech uses وديني.

exercises.tip: "وديني" means take me, and "على" gives the place.

challenge.title: Getting Around Cairo
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines about getting to a meeting place across town. It must include calling or boarding a taxi or microbus, asking the fare, asking for directions to a specific place, naming at least two places in town, and thanking the driver or the person who helped you. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 5 and include both a masculine-address and a feminine-address form.
required_elements: A request to a driver using عايز أروح or عايزة أروح.
A question about the fare using كام.
At least one turn instruction using لفّ or على طول.
At least two named places, for example السوق, الجامع, البنك, or المحطة.
A thank-you exchange using شكراً قوي or ربنا يخليك.
One masculine-address form and one feminine-address form, for example اتفضل and اتفضلي.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.english: Please, I want to go to the market.

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: Okay, get in.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.english: About how much is the fare?

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: About twenty-five pounds.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.arabic: طب وبعد كده هروح البنك، بعيد من السوق؟
dialogue.transliteration: Tab w-ba3d kaddah harooh el-bank, ba3eed min es-soo2?
dialogue.english: Okay, and then I'll go to the bank, is it far from the market?

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.arabic: لأ، قريب، لفّي يمين بعد الجامع وهتلاقيه.
dialogue.transliteration: la2, 2areeb, liffi yemeen ba3d el-gaame3 w-hatla2eeh.
dialogue.english: No, near, turn right after the mosque and you'll find it.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.arabic: حلو، وقّف هنا قدّام السوق لو سمحت.
dialogue.english: Nice, stop here in front of the market please.

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: There you go, we have arrived.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.english: How much do I owe?

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: Just twenty-five pounds.

dialogue.speaker: سلمى
dialogue.english: Here, keep the change. Thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: سواق
dialogue.english: Thank you, have a good day.
